name: @pipeworx/mcp-brazil-comex-stat

tools.name: br_trade_flows
tools.description: Brazil exports/imports over a date range, from MDIC Comex Stat — Brazil’s own customs trade statistics, PROXIED LIVE (not a bulk copy). Monthly granularity at NCM8 (Brazil’s 8-digit national tariff code, finer than the HS6 that UN Comtrade reports for Brazil), with an optional breakdown by Brazilian state of origin/destination — a dimension Comtrade does not have. Filter by a specific NCM product code, an NCM/HS chapter (2-digit), a partner country, and/or a Brazilian state; any combination, or none (totals). Returns value in USD FOB and net weight in kg, with every code resolved to its name. Use for "Brazil’s soybean exports to China by month in 2025" (ncm="12019000", country="China", from="2025-01", to="2025-12") or "Mato Grosso’s exports in Q1 2025" (state="MT", from="2025-01", to="2025-03").

ncm.description: Full 8-digit NCM product code (e.g. "12019000" = soybeans, other than for sowing). Omit for all products.

chapter.description: 2-digit NCM/HS chapter code (e.g. "12" = oilseeds and grains, "27" = mineral fuels/oils). Omit for all chapters. Use this OR ncm, not both.

country.description: Partner country name (e.g. "China", "United States") or Comex Stat country id. Omit for all countries (world total).

state.description: Brazilian state name or two-letter UF abbreviation (e.g. "Mato Grosso" or "MT"). Omit for all of Brazil.

to.description: End of period: "YYYY" or "YYYY-MM" (e.g. "2025" or "2025-12"). Inclusive.

monthly.description: true (default) returns one row per month; false collapses the whole period into a single total.

tools.name: br_trade_top_partners
tools.description: Top partner countries for a Brazilian product in a given year, from MDIC Comex Stat (live proxy). Pass either an 8-digit NCM code or a 2-digit NCM/HS chapter; omit both for Brazil’s overall top trading partners that year. Sorted descending by value (USD FOB). Use for "top destinations for Brazilian soybeans in 2025" (ncm="12019000", year="2025") or "Brazil’s biggest export markets overall in 2025" (year="2025").

ncm.description: Full 8-digit NCM product code (e.g. "12019000" = soybeans). Use this OR chapter, not both; omit both for overall totals.

chapter.description: 2-digit NCM/HS chapter code (e.g. "12" = oilseeds and grains).

limit.description: Max partner countries to return. Defaults to 10, capped at 50.

tools.name: br_trade_top_products
tools.description: Top NCM chapters (broad product categories) Brazil traded with a given country in a given year, from MDIC Comex Stat (live proxy). Sorted descending by value (USD FOB). Use for "what does Brazil export to China" (country="China", year="2025") or "top US imports from Brazil in 2025" (flow="import", country="United States", year="2025" — note: Comex Stat reports flow from BRAZIL’s side, so flow="import" means Brazil’s imports FROM that country).

flow.description: Trade direction from Brazil’s side: "export" or "import". Defaults to "export".

country.description: Partner country name (e.g. "China") or Comex Stat country id.

limit.description: Max product chapters to return. Defaults to 10, capped at 50.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-brazil-comex-stat forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the brazil-comex-stat pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
